nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a machine, $l'$ a list over its output alphabet and $\mathrm{acc}$ an output symbol. The halting configuration with output $l'$ (halted, in the initial state, with $l'$ on the output stack and every other stack empty) is accepting for $\mathrm{acc}$ if and only if $l'$ is nonempty and its first element is $\mathrm{acc}$.
nodes.title: Acceptance of a halting configuration

nodes.title: Transition families with a run-literal head are satisfied by the run

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an encoding of the machine $M$, let $x$, $y$ and $Y$ be words over the input alphabet such that every letter of $y$ occurs in $Y$, and let $m$, $T$ and $H$ be natural numbers with $|xy| \le m < H$, where $xy$ is the concatenation. Then the assignment of the real run's literals of $xy$ for $T$ steps at height $H$ satisfies the init family (clauses I1 to I6) for $x$, $Y$, $m$, $T$ and $H$.
nodes.title: Completeness of the init family

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be an encoding of the machine $M$ with $K$ stacks, let $s$ be a word over the input alphabet, and let $H$, $k$ and $j$ be natural numbers with $k < K$ and $j < H$. Let $x$ be the code of the cell of stack $k$ at depth $j$ in the initial configuration on $s$. Then the cell variable of time $0$, stack $k$, depth $j$ and symbol code $x$ at height $H$ is one of the real run's literals of $s$ at height $H$.
nodes.title: Row-0 cells of the start configuration are run literals

nodes.summary: Let $b$, $i$, $i'$ and $n$ be natural numbers. If $\lfloor i / b^e \rfloor \bmod b = \lfloor i' / b^e \rfloor \bmod b$ for every $e < n$, that is, $i$ and $i'$ have the same first $n$ base-$b$ digits, then $i \bmod b^n = i' \bmod b^n$.
nodes.title: Equal low-order digits give equal residues

nodes.summary: Let $W$, $t$, $t'$, $r$ and $r'$ be natural numbers with $r < W$ and $r' < W$. If $tW + r = t'W + r'$, then $t = t'$ and $r = r'$.

The assignment is the list of $V$ truth values whose entry $p$, for each $p < V$, is true exactly when $p$ is one of the real run's literals of $s$ at height $H$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
